Structure rebuild 2026-11-15 (photos/SOURCES.md): head, yoke and stand mount measured on the straight-on dealer photo front.jpg (1752 px from the head apex to the mount bottom = 295 mm, so 0.1684 mm per px; the 99 mm width is the yoke knob to knob, the head is 63 mm wide). The grille weave, flat finishes, the four engraved band lines and a blank badge disc are printed graphics generated by us (no photo and no lettering on the model).

Structure rebuild 2026-11-15 (photos/SOURCES.md): head, yoke and stand mount measured on the straight-on dealer photo front.jpg (1752 px from the head apex to the mount bottom = 295 mm, so 0.1684 mm per px; the 99 mm width is the yoke knob to knob, the head is 63 mm wide). The grille weave, flat finishes, the four engraved band lines and a blank badge disc are printed graphics generated by us (no photo and no lettering on the model). The one-sheet size 295 x 99 x 64 mm is the whole assembly: the width is the yoke knob to knob, the height includes the stand mount. A hidden 99 mm wide axle core inside the trunnion hubs lets the oval lathe satisfy its width rule while the head is 63 mm wide. No rear view exists in any source: the rear of the band repeats the front lines without the badge (not seen). The cable boot on the rear wall seen in side.jpg is not modelled.

Second structure rebuild 2026-11-15 (builder S-aea2, review defects 1 to 13): the yoke is one flat band (12 mm deep x 3.4 mm thick) made of four prisms, the stem is black, the adapter has a collar opening, a cup with the 16 mm threaded bore, a cable clip, the ribbed boot and the cable, the grille is 63.4 mm and the bands 64.4 mm, 64 segments, grooves in the lower band, a raised badge rim. Measured again on front.jpg, side.jpg and the Thomann views.

Third structure pass 2026-11-15 (builder S-aea3, review 2 defects): one continuous yoke strap, no needle pin, 36-tooth knobs with slotted screw, collar opening 19 mm x 4 mm, S-curve 16-sided cable, raised badge disc. Earlier: second pass (S-aea2, review defects 1 to 13): the yoke is one flat band (12 mm deep x 3.4 mm thick) made of four prisms, the stem is black, the adapter has a collar opening, a cup with the 16 mm threaded bore, a cable clip, the ribbed boot and the cable, the grille is 63.4 mm and the bands 64.4 mm, 64 segments, grooves in the lower band, a raised badge rim. Measured again on front.jpg, side.jpg and the Thomann views.

Fourth structure pass 2026-11-15 (builder S-aea4, review 3 defects 2 to 11): collar slit closed and opening 22 mm, the whole yoke strap in ONE frame (no apex seam), stem 12.6 mm, nut 10.9 x 6.3 mm, lip 25.2 mm, two hinge screws per side on the lower band, knob 19 x 4.4 mm, photo-driven painted chrome, grille pitch 2.7 mm, 12-station dome, ribbed boot (9 to 7.5 mm) and short closed cable stubs kept inside the 64 mm depth (the long outward cable loop is an accessory outside the datasheet box and is not modelled).
